description: Adding a library document to a meeting, removing and detaching meeting documents.
precondition: Meeting with documents; personal library documents.

preconditions: Meeting Published; Chair; agenda item A1 exists; documents M1, M2 are in the meeting and not linked to A1.
cases.inputs: agendaItemId: A1; source: existing meeting documents; documentIds: [M1, M2].
cases.log: Two links (M1-A1, M2-A1) added; links to other items untouched.

preconditions: Meeting Published; Secretary; M1 is in the meeting; agendaItemId does not belong to this meeting.
cases.inputs: agendaItemId: unknown id; source: existing meeting documents; documentIds: [M1].
cases.return: Failure AgendaItemNotFound (HTTP 404, MSG242); no link added.

preconditions: Meeting Published; actor is a Member (not Chair or Secretary); M1 is in the meeting; agendaItemId A1 exists.
cases.inputs: agendaItemId: A1; source: existing meeting documents; documentIds: [M1].
cases.return: Failure Forbidden (HTTP 403, MSG240); no link added.
